record.title: Benapole–Petrapole announced freight holiday for Durga Puja, October 2022
record.direction: Both directions for the specified freight; see each phase for any narrower scope.
record.exceptions: Passenger immigration and unloading goods already inside the port continued.

record.enforcement: Petrapole C&F official Kartik Chakraborty gave the 2–5 October trade holiday and planned 6 October return. Officials described goods interchange already stopped on Sunday 2 October while passenger passage and unloading of previously imported goods continued.
record.consequences: No general economic effect is quantified by this research packet.
record.relationship: Separate October 2022 holiday episode, distinct from January–February 2022 strike and May 2024/April 2026 election restrictions.
